messages.author: df1e8c4ee64c5304
messages.subject: shiny::renderDataTable is deprecated
parts:
Greetings, all:

First, thanks to all for the creation of Shiny and Shiny Stan.  They are very nice packages.  That having been said, I got an informational warning when I ran launch_shinystan():
shiny::renderDataTable is deprecated. Please use DT::renderDataTable instead. To disable this message, run options(shiny.deprecation.messages=FALSE) (Last used in version 0.11.1)

So I looked at my search path and found that DT was not loaded.  I loaded DT (library(DT)), and got the response:
The following objects are masked from ‘package:shiny’:

    dataTableOutput, renderDataTable

No more warnings!  It might be less confusion to other neophytes like me to make package DT required for loading package ShinyStan.  

Again, thanks for these packages.

Larry Hunsicker

messages.author: fc5d3270037d7478
messages.subject: Re: shiny::renderDataTable is deprecated
parts:
Hi Larry, 

Thanks for bringing this up. I've been working on an update for shinyStan that (among many other things) will take care of this. 

It was never the intention for users to have to figure out the issue and load DT manually, but shiny has been changing fast and some issues like this happen when they deprecate functions (or make other changes) and packages based on shiny have to catch up. There hasn't been a shinyStan update since shiny deprecated these functions, hence the warnings. But the update will be ready soon. 

Jonah
